Container.Name: Kivo
Container.Overview: Kivo, a self-hosted media server. Host networking lets apps find it on your network; on a bridge network, type the address instead.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Address and port Kivo listens on.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: server.toml, if you use one; environment variables work instead.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, uploaded artwork and backups. Keep it on a local disk or cache pool, never a share.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Artwork, previews and transcode segments. Safe to delete.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media. Kivo never writes here.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions mask for files Kivo creates.

Config.Name: Base path
Config.Description: Serve under a subpath such as /kivo, behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses or ranges of your reverse proxy, so client addresses come through.
